info.description:
Commons Impact Metrics provides analytical data on the impact of community
contributions to Wikimedia Commons, focused on contributions from galleries,
libraries, archives, and museums. Data provided by this API is available
under the [CC0 1.0 license](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
info.title: Wikimedia Commons Impact Metrics API

get.description: Returns a time series with metrics about the given Commons category and category tree, including media file counts and leverage counts.

parameters.description: The title of the desired category, in URL format
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: First month (inclusive), in YYYYMM01 format
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Last month (exclusive), in YYYYMM01 format
parameters.name: end

get.summary: Get time series of category metrics

get.description: Returns a time series of the number of edits to Commons media files associated to the given category or category tree.

parameters.description: The title of the desired category, in URL format
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Plain category counts (shallow) or top-level category tree counts (deep)
parameters.name: category-scope

parameters.description: The type of edit: create, update or all-edit-types
parameters.name: edit-type

parameters.description: First month (inclusive), in YYYYMM01 format
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Last month (exclusive), in YYYYMM01 format
parameters.name: end

get.summary: Get time series of edit counts for a given category
